newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche to arrange 1 bln dmk Russia credit.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche to arrange 1 bln dmk Russia credit.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Monday it had been mandated by Russia's Vneshekonombank to arrange a one billion-mark credit package to finance German investment goods exports to Russia.
The agreement followed talks between Deutsche Bank and the Russian finance ministry, Deutsche said in a statement.
Deutsche to arrange 1 bln dmk Russia credit

Deutsche said the package had two components: a tranche backed by the German state-backed Hermes export credit guarantee scheme to cover 85 percent of the investment good deliveries and a further tranche, which will not be covered by Hermes, to cover the remaining 15 percent.

The statement said Deutsche and Vneshekonombank were considering involving Frankfurt-based AKA Ausfuhrkredit-Gesellschaft mbH, the German Export Credit Company, an organisation experienced in Russian credit business.
Deutsche plans to invite AKA's consortium banks to contribute towards the financing package.
The aim of the agreement is to create the conditions for a rapid use of this year's Hermes credit guarantees in the interest of German exporters and Russian importers, the statement said.
